## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: A new feature or UI addition
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `refactor`: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `style`: Formatting, missing semicolons, etc.
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvements
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, build config, or dependency updates

## Checklist

Please verify and check the following before submitting:

- [ ] My branch is named according to conventions (`feat/`, `fix/`, `docs/`, `refactor/`).
- [ ] `./gradlew assembleDebug` passes without build errors.
- [ ] `./gradlew lintDebug` passes with no new lint errors or warnings.
- [ ] Code strictly follows [docs/Rules.md](../docs/Rules.md) (4-space indent, max 120 chars, no wildcard imports).
- [ ] Screenshots or screen recordings are attached for any UI changes.
- [ ] PR description clearly explains the rationale and purpose of the changes.
